message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 18 November 2026 07:40 to 19 November 2026 07:40 UTC (13:10 IST). **Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only, plus the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep. Duplicate component names were normalized while retaining listed versions.

No newly reported vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the listed DLL components within the exact 24-hour window. Search results and publication timestamps are incomplete, so this is not a guarantee that no issue exists; installed versions have not been independently verified.

### MongoDB ecosystem

No newly disclosed MongoDB-family vulnerability was verified within the window. [Percona Server for MongoDB 8.3.17-5](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/release_notes/8.3.17-5.html), dated 18 November, fixes multiple upstream issues, including CVE-2026-120813, which can cause fields intended for encryption to be stored in plaintext. MongoDB lists that CVE on 10 November, so it is not a new disclosure; the Percona release time could not be verified against the exact window. Percona Server is not named in the DLL inventory. MongoDB rates CVE-2026-120813 CVSS 4.0 8.2. [MongoDB alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

The additional sweep covered MongoDB Server and editions, mongod/mongos, Atlas and services, management tools, Compass, mongosh, database tools, operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services and official libraries and integrations. Available vendor alerts and targeted public advisory searches were reviewed; coverage is limited by search indexing and available timestamps.

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended on the basis of a verified new DLL finding in this scan. Review the Percona release if that separately deployed product is in use; do not assume the scan establishes that existing components are free of vulnerabilities.
